response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.product_color AS color, SUM(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS qty FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), t AS (SELECT color, qty, qty * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM c) AS share, (SELECT AVG(qty * 1.0) FROM c) AS avg_qty FROM c) SELECT AVG(qty * 1.0) AS avg_quantity, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(qty - avg_qty) AS avg_excess FROM t WHERE qty > avg_qty
